meta.title: Scenario: matrix organisation (Compass Partners)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-scenarios.ts (matrix-organisation) with seed 20261104. 30 members. The team attribute holds each member’s function (line management: Engineering, Design, Data, Delivery, Shared Services; two contractors have none recorded), while day-to-day work happens in three cross-functional programmes (the programme attribute; six members also work on a second programme). Programme members collaborate formally and informally every day; function colleagues on other programmes meet only for required chapter meetings and line management, so their ties are formal without informal collaboration. Programme leads: DEL02 (Atlas), DEL03 (Beacon), DEL04 (Cobalt).
